class: PROSPECTIVE_POST_O2_8_MINIMAL_COMPOSITE_RESOURCE_FRONTIER (OPERATIONAL; not a mechanism search / model competition / re-confirmation)
question: Smallest target-imagery acquisition that operationally estimates the complete O2.8-supported composite geometry and closes >=half the native-oracle gap on unseen imagery identities, in BOTH primary ROIs?

frozen_geometry.within_support_estimator: DIRECT target residual subspace inside col(W_target): U_IN = top-q left singular vectors of Z_C.T; B_IN=W_target U_IN; P_IN=B_IN B_IN.T
frozen_geometry.q: min(r_best, M) (sample-limited operational rank; frozen; WITHIN_RANK_FRACTION=q/r_best descriptive)
frozen_geometry.outside_estimator: B_OUT = top-2 left singular vectors of D_OUT_C (V x M); P_OUT=B_OUT B_OUT.T
frozen_geometry.P_COMP: P_IN + P_OUT (orthogonal ranges; certify sym<=1e-10, idem<=1e-8, cross<=1e-10, rank=q+2)

operational_cost.N_TRIALS: M x T (D fixed at 2 does not enter the count)

residual.delta_i(S): mean_{t in S} delta_trial(i,t) (certified O2.7 trial state, no extra normalization)

numerical_rank_rule: tol = eps_float64 * max(shape) * s_max ; rank = count(s > tol) ; frozen, no outcome-specific tolerance

rank_guards.no_subset_dropping: any required subset rank-insufficient -> RESOURCE_CELL_NON_EVALUABLE for that participant x ROI x M x T; do NOT average survivors; group cell needs 8/8 evaluable

eval.on: 2 sealed outer-test imagery residual centroids only

references.R111: sealed O2.8 participant-level (M10,D2,within rank-r oracle) capacity reference

replay_gate.O2_9_FULL_COMPOSITE_REPLAYS_O2_8_R111: sealed-centroid delta_native M10,D2,q=r_best (direct within + outside SVD) reproduces O2.8 R111 <=1e-10 (participant); NOT trial means; else STOP

operational_full_resource_cell: M10,T8 uses mean of all 8 certified trial residuals (like every T cell), NOT sealed delta_native; agreement with R111 reported descriptively; if M10,T8 fails the criterion there is NO established operational solution

metrics.TOTAL_RECOVERY_COMP(M,T): (R_COMP - R0)/max(R_NATIVE_ORACLE - R0, 1e-12) (clipped [0,1] + unclipped) -- primary resource criterion

resource_cell_success.no_pvalue: O2.8 already established held-out signal via participant-level exact inference; O2.9 is a resource frontier, not a discovery test

common_frontier.COMMON_SUCCESS(M,T): same M,T OPERATIONALLY_SUFFICIENT in BOTH ventral and lateral (no ROI mixing)
common_frontier.MINIMAL_RESOURCE_SET: ALL common-success cells with M*T==N_TRIALS_STAR (report all ties)
common_frontier.pareto: common nondominated cells: (M,T) dominates (M',T') if M<=M' and T<=T' with one strict; persist all nondominated

diagnostics_descriptive: monotonicity (M at fixed T, T at fixed M; report non-monotonicity honestly, no isotonic smoothing)
within-support singular spectra + q + boundary ratio s_{q+1}/s_q

gram_optimization.allowed: mathematically equivalent small Gram matrices (outside G=D.T D, h=D.T delta -> energy sum (v.h)^2/lambda; within via Z_C Gram)
gram_optimization.require_data_free_equivalence: Gram vs direct SVD/projector <=1e-10; do NOT change scientific formulas

expected_counts: per participant x ROI x M x T: 6 folds x N_id_subsets(M) x N_rep_subsets(T); exact; no selective averaging

roi_status.COMPOSITE_OPERATIONAL_RECOVERY_NOT_ESTAB: M10,T8 evaluable but fails the frozen criterion

program_status.COMPOSITE_TARGET_STATE_CALIBRATION_MULTI: each ROI has sufficient cells but NO single (M,T) sufficient in both
program_status.COMPOSITE_OPERATIONAL_RECOVERY_NOT_ESTAB: full resource M10,T8 insufficient in >=1 otherwise-valid ROI

M_interpretation: OPERATIONAL resource axis (identity diversity of outside basis + within-support sample rank + acquisition diversity); NOT a new causal attribution to O2.8 factor A alone
resource_claim_boundary: allowed: smallest tested common calibration burden that closed >=half the native-oracle gap in both ROIs, with successful combinations as the frozen empirical frontier; NOT 'N trials universally calibrate imagery / biological minimum / brain needs M identities / D=2 is imagery dimensionality'

next_gate.MINIMAL_COMPOSITE_TARGET_STATE_CALIBRATI: O2.10 COMPOSITE TARGET-STATE GEOMETRY SHAREDNESS (cross-participant predictability/transfer of the D=2 outside basis + within-support subspace); O3 not auto-unlocked
